summary: The stale Sentinel runbook was replaced with an explicit retirement notice linking to the standalone repository.

evidence: docs/sentinel.md is reduced to a 10-line retirement notice stating that embedded automation and local verification tooling must not be restored here.

The notice links operators to the standalone ubiquity/sentinel repository.
